claims: "One Battle After Another" won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026.
Paul Thomas Anderson directed "One Battle After Another".
"One Battle After Another" won six total trophies at the 98th Academy Awards.
"One Battle After Another" won Best Casting at the 98th Academy Awards.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony was held on March 15, 2026.
Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Director for "One Battle After Another" at the 98th Academy Awards.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for "Sinners" at the 98th Academy Awards.
Jessie Buckley won Best Actress for "Hamnet" at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor for "One Battle After Another" at the 98th Academy Awards.
Amy Madigan won Best Supporting Actress for "Weapons" at the 98th Academy Awards.
"Sinners" set a record with 16 nominations at the 98th Academy Awards.
"Sinners" won four awards at the 98th Academy Awards.
